title: 第19章 许平秋的创收第20章 吃面不给钱
lines: 不多时，轮到了许平秋上前测验。
前面测验的人似乎都通过了，并没有什么淘汰的说法。
想想也是，能通过福缘舟的考验，要是没有灵脉那才不对劲。
就是测验完，少了通报灵脉等阶的环节，转而被天墟弟子记录在了颁发的令牌中。
这让许平秋有种浑身蚂蚁在爬的感觉，很像自己抽卡出了双黄甚至更多，但却找不到地方炫耀！
而那枚令牌似乎就是弟子令牌，和那些天墟弟子腰间款式一样样，测灵之后就能拿到。
这样看起来，后面的考验都不会淘汰人了。
就是不知道在福缘舟之前，还有没有其他考验了。
许平秋希望有，不然他这后门走的就太没劲了。
落座后，面前的弟子照例询问了姓名，将其记录在令牌后，便是搭脉探查。
一缕灵力顺着手腕游入许平秋的体内，许平秋有些惊讶的发现，他们的灵力好像和乐临清的不太一样。
乐临清的灵力进入体内后有种暖洋洋的感觉，游走在灵脉中还蛮舒服的，但眼前弟子的却令许平秋一点感觉都没有。
他不知道这是被乐临清整的阈值提升了，还是他们功法不同的问题。
不过在许平秋面无表情的同时，他对面的弟子却露出了惊讶的神色，眼睛瞪的像铜铃。
一旁的姚元明察觉到他的神色变化，当即传音询问原因，但听到是天脉的时候，瞬间坐不住，也走上前来，伸手又搭在了许平秋手上。
许平秋露出了疑惑的神色，在这之前，并没有人经历两次探查。
姚元明探查一番后，也和那名弟子一样，露出了惊讶的神色。
因为天脉已经许久没有出现过，而且窥探多出的那一百零一道灵脉，再对比自己体内的灵脉，那种差异带来的感觉隐约有一种玄妙感，令人欲罢不能。
这也吸引了不少人的注意力，尤其是其他的弟子，在互相传音后，纷纷放弃了自己面前的队伍，来到了许平秋面前，跃跃欲试。
这令许平秋感觉自己好像个站街女，谁都可以测一下。
是可忍孰不可忍，于是许平秋愤怒的将手收回，在姚元明等人露出尴尬神色中，小声说道：“想看可以，一次十贡献点，概不讲价。”
姚元明原本已经想好该如何道歉，毕竟这事确实是他们不对，好不容易遇到一个活的，能测的天脉，情不自禁了属于是。
但许平秋这一句话，整的他有些措手不及，不只是姚元明，其他弟子也傻眼了。
“成交！”
一名弟子当即在大庭广众下与许平秋达成了py交易。
直接往桌上，许平秋还没到手的个人令牌转了十贡献点。
“行，一个个来，排好队。”许平秋满意的点了点头，当即开始招呼他们排队。
既然没有办法吃软饭，那就只能自己创收了。
这一幕给身后李成周看傻了，而其他排队参与测验的人也懵了，这是什么神展开？
content_en:
Not long after, it was Xu Pingqiu's turn to step forward for the test.
Everyone who took the previous test seemed to have passed, and there was no such thing as elimination.
Thinking about it, if you can pass the test of Fu Yuan Zhou, it would be wrong if you don't have spiritual veins.
After the test, there was no need to report the level of the spiritual veins, and instead it was recorded in the token issued by the disciples of Tianxu.
This made Xu Pingqiu feel like there were ants crawling all over his body, much like he had drawn double yellows or even more, but couldn't find a place to show off!
And that token seems to be the disciple token. It has the same style as those worn by Tianxu disciples. It can be obtained after soul testing.
It seems that no one will be eliminated in subsequent tests.
I just don’t know if there are any other tests before Fu Yuan Zhou.
Xu Pingqiu hoped so, otherwise his backdoor approach would be too boring.
After sitting down, the disciple in front of him asked for his name as usual and recorded it behind the token to take a pulse test.
A ray of spiritual power swam into Xu Pingqiu's body along his wrist. Xu Pingqiu was a little surprised to find that their spiritual power seemed to be different from Le Linqing's.
Le Linqing felt a warm feeling after his spiritual power entered his body. It was quite comfortable to swim in the spiritual veins, but the disciple in front of him made Xu Pingqiu feel nothing at all.
He didn't know if this was because Le Linqingzheng's threshold had been raised, or if it was a matter of their different skills.
However, while Xu Pingqiu was expressionless, the disciple opposite him showed a look of surprise, his eyes as wide as bells.
Yao Yuanming on the side noticed the change in his expression, and immediately sent a message to ask for the reason. But when he heard that it was Tianmai, he couldn't sit still for an instant, and he also stepped forward and put his hand on Xu Pingqiu's hand.
Xu Pingqiu showed a puzzled look. No one had experienced two explorations before this.
After Yao Yuanming made some inquiries, he showed the same surprised look as the disciple.
Because the heavenly veins have not appeared for a long time, and when you look at the extra one hundred and one spiritual veins, and then compare them with the spiritual veins in your own body, the difference brings about a vague sense of mystery, which makes you want to stop.
This also attracted the attention of many people, especially other disciples. After transmitting messages to each other, they all gave up the team in front of them and came to Xu Pingqiu, eager to try.
This made Xu Pingqiu feel like a street girl who could be tested by anyone.
It was unbearable, so Xu Pingqiu took his hand back angrily, and while Yao Yuanming and others looked embarrassed, he whispered: "You can see if you want, I will contribute ten points at a time, no bargaining."
"Well..."
"Huh??!"
Yao Yuanming had already thought about how to apologize. After all, it was indeed their fault. After finally meeting a living person who could measure the heavenly pulse, he couldn't help but feel that it was yes.
But Xu Pingqiu's words caught him off guard. Not only Yao Yuanming, but also other disciples were dumbfounded.
"Deal!"
A disciple immediately reached a py deal with Xu Pingqiu in public.
Directly on the table, Xu Pingqiu transferred ten contribution points to the personal token he had not yet received.
"Okay, come one by one and line up." Xu Pingqiu nodded with satisfaction and immediately started to greet them to line up.
Since there is no way to make a living, you can only generate income by yourself.
This scene made Li Chengzhou behind him dumbfounded, and other people queuing up to take the test were also confused. What kind of divine unfolding was this?
title_en: Chapter 19 Xu Pingqiu’s Income Generation Chapter 20 Eating noodles without giving money
